Research task: analyze Anthropic's consumer-facing legal documents as reference for drafting Terms of Service + Privacy Policy for a free AI-agent pilot.

Fetch (WebFetch or curl; if 404, find current URL via WebSearch):
1. https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms
2. https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
3. https://www.anthropic.com/legal/aup (usage policy)

Return a structured plain-text report (data for another agent, not human-facing):
A. CONSUMER TERMS: full section outline in order.
B. Short verbatim excerpts for: (1) AS IS/warranty disclaimer, (2) limitation of liability + cap, (3) indemnity, (4) AI output disclaimer/accuracy, (5) changes to terms, (6) termination, (7) minimum age, (8) third-party services, (9) feedback, (10) input/output ownership, (11) beta/preview/research features, (12) free-service specific language if any.
C. PRIVACY POLICY: section outline; key language on: categories collected, model-training use and defaults/opt-outs, retention, deletion, aggregated/de-identified data, security, children, contact.
D. Tone/UX observations (plain-language summaries, reassurance framing).
Under 1500 words. Facts only.

content.content:
# Consumer Terms of Service - Section Outline & Key Excerpts

**Effective Date:** October 8, 2025

## Full Section Outline

1. Who we are
2. Account creation and access
3. Use of our Services
4. Inputs, Outputs, Actions, and Materials
5. Feedback
6. Subscriptions, fees and payment
7. Third-party services and links
8. Content Moderation
9. Software
10. Ownership of the Services
11. Disclaimer of warranties, limitations of liability, and indemnity
12. Data Switching and Portability
13. General terms
14. In case of disputes

---

## Key Excerpts (Verbatim, ≤125 characters each)

**(1) AS IS / Warranty Disclaimer:**
"The Services, Outputs, and Actions are provided on an 'as is' and 'as available' basis and...are provided without warranties"

**(2) Limitation of Liability:**
"our total liability to you...will be limited to the greater of: (a) the amount you paid to us...in the six months prior...and (b) €100"

**(3) Indemnity:**
No indemnity clause found in provided text.

**(4) AI Output Accuracy Disclaimer:**
"Outputs may not always be accurate and may contain material inaccuracies even if they appear accurate"

**(5) Changes/Updates to Terms:**
"These changes will come into effect no less than 30 days from when we notify you, unless the change is due to a change in law"

**(6) Termination:**
"We may suspend or terminate your access to the Services at any time without notice to you if: we believe that you have materially breached"

**(7) Minimum Age Requirement:**
"You must be at least 18 years old to use the Services"

**(8) Third-Party Services:**
"We do not control or accept responsibility for any loss or damage that may arise from your use of any Third-Party Content"

**(9) Feedback:**
"If you rate an Output...we will store the related conversation as part of your Feedback...we may use the Feedback however we choose"

**(10) Ownership of Inputs/Outputs:**
"you retain any right, title, and interest that you have in such Inputs. Subject to your compliance...we assign to you all our right, title, and interest in Outputs"

**(11) Beta/Preview/Research Features:**
"In some cases, we may permit you to evaluate our Services for a limited time or with limited functionality...for your personal, non-commercial use only"

**(12) Free Services Language:**
No specific free service disclaimers found; terms address "non-commercial use" for evaluation access.

---

## Plain Language Features

The document contains **no dedicated summary boxes**, but uses **bold formatting** for key defined terms and organized section headers for readability.

# Anthropic Usage Policy Overview

## Full Section Outline

1. **Universal Usage Standards** (10 subsections)
2. **High-Risk Use Case Requirements**
3. **Additional Use Case Guidelines**

---

## Main Prohibited Use Categories

The policy forbids:

- **Legal violations** – illegal substances, trafficking, IP infringement
- **Infrastructure threats** – disrupting power grids, healthcare systems, voting machines
- **Cyberattacks** – unauthorized access, malware, botnets, bypassing security controls
- **Weapons development** – designing explosives, biological/chemical/nuclear weapons
- **Violence & hate** – inciting extremism, terrorism, discrimination
- **Privacy violations** – unauthorized data access, impersonation
- **Child safety** – CSAM, grooming, exploitation, sexualization of minors
- **Psychological harm** – suicide/self-harm promotion, harassment, animal cruelty
- **Misinformation** – false medical/political/legal information, deepfakes
- **Election interference** – deceptive vote targeting, fake movements, voter suppression
- **Surveillance abuse** – facial recognition, predictive policing, emotional tracking
- **Fraud & abuse** – counterfeit goods, phishing, fake documents, predatory lending
- **Platform abuse** – account circumvention, jailbreaking, model scraping
- **Sexual content** – explicit material, incest, bestiality

---

## High-Risk Use Cases & Oversight

Certain domains require two safeguards:

1. **"Human-in-the-loop"** – "a qualified professional in that field must review the content or decision" before dissemination when affecting individuals
2. **Disclosure requirement** – Users must be told AI assisted with decisions in: legal advice, healthcare, insurance, finance, hiring/housing, academic testing, and journalism

---

## Additional Guidelines

- All consumer chatbots must disclose AI involvement at session start
- Products serving minors require additional compliance measures
- Agentic applications must follow the full policy
- Model Context Protocol servers must meet directory requirements

---

## Tone Features

The document uses **accessible language** with specific examples throughout (e.g., "power grids, water treatment facilities"), structured bullet points for clarity, and direct prohibitions phrased as "do not" statements, making it readable for non-lawyers while maintaining legal precision.

# Privacy Policy Section Outline

1. Collection of Personal Data
2. Uses of Personal Data Permitted Under Applicable Data Protection Laws
3. Recipients and Third-Party Data Sources
4. Rights and Choices
5. Data Transfers
6. Data Retention, Data Lifecycle, and Security Controls
7. Children
8. Changes to Our Privacy Policy
9. Contact Information
10. Legal Bases for Processing
11. Regional Supplemental Disclosures

---

## Summary by Topic

**Effective Date:** July 8, 2026

**Tone:** Formal, comprehensive legal document with section references and links to additional resources.

---

### (a) Categories of Personal Data Collected

Identity and contact information, payment data, user-generated inputs/outputs, feedback, technical information (device, connection, usage, logs, cookies), study participation data, communication records, and verification data including biometric information.

---

### (b) Model Training Use, Defaults, and Opt-Outs

Default: Data is used for model training unless opted out.

Anthropic states: *"We may use your Inputs and Outputs to train and improve Anthropic AI models, unless you opt out through your account settings."*

Exception: *"Even if you opt-out, we will use Inputs and Outputs for model training when: (i) your conversations are flagged for safety review...or (ii) you've explicitly reported the materials to us."*

Separate Non-User Privacy Policy governs third-party training data practices.

---

### (c) Data Retention Periods

*"Anthropic retains your personal data for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes and criteria outlined in this Privacy Policy."*

Specific guidance referenced in their privacy center; individual conversations deleted within 30 days after user deletion.

---

### (d) Deletion Rights and Process

Users have *"the right to request that we delete personal data collected from you...subject to certain exceptions."*

Users can *"delete individual conversations, which will be removed immediately from your conversation history and automatically deleted from our back-end within 30 days."*

Submit requests to privacy@anthropic.com; response within 30 days typically (or extended period if complex).

---

### (e) Aggregated/De-Identified Data Language

*"We apply aggregation and de-identification techniques where appropriate as part of our data minimization practices."*

*"Where data is de-identified, Anthropic will maintain and use this information in its de-identified form, and will not attempt to re-identify such information, except as permitted by law."*

---

### (f) Security Measures Language

*"We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures designed to protect personal data from loss, misuse, and unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction."*

No detailed technical specifications provided.

---

### (g) Children/Minors Language

*"Our Services are not directed towards, and we do not knowingly collect, use, disclose, sell, or share any information from children under the age of 18."*

Detection and removal measures in place; report suspected violations to privacy@anthropic.com.

---

### (h) Contact Information

**Mailing Addresses:**
- Anthropic PBC: 548 Market St, PMB 90375, San Francisco, CA 94104
- Anthropic Ireland, Limited: 6th Floor, South Bank House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, D04 TR29

**Email:** privacy@anthropic.com  
**Data Protection Officer:** dpo@anthropic.com

Regional complaints procedures listed for EU, UK, Brazil, and Australia.

curl -sL https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms -o /tmp/terms.html && wc -c /tmp/terms.html && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, html
raw = open('/tmp/terms.html', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore').read()
# strip scripts/styles/tags
raw = re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>', ' ', raw, flags=re.S)
raw = re.sub(r'<style.*?</style>', ' ', raw, flags=re.S)
txt = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '\n', raw)
txt = html.unescape(txt)
txt = re.sub(r'\n\s*\n+', '\n', txt)
open('/tmp/terms.txt','w').write(txt)
print(len(txt))
EOF

REPORT: ANTHROPIC CONSUMER LEGAL DOCS — REFERENCE ANALYSIS
Sources fetched 2026-07-27: anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms (Effective Oct 8, 2025 — NOTE: server returned the EU/EEA-Switzerland consumer version, contracting party "Anthropic Ireland, Limited"; a separate US version exists with likely differences: USD cap, arbitration, indemnity), anthropic.com/legal/privacy (Effective July 8, 2026), anthropic.com/legal/aup (Usage Policy).

A. CONSUMER TERMS — FULL SECTION OUTLINE (in order)
Preamble (parties, scope, consumer definition, pointer to Privacy Policy and Commercial Terms) / 1. Who we are / 2. Account creation and access (Minimum age; Your Anthropic Account; Business Domains; Evaluation and Additional Services) / 3. Use of our Services (Permitted Use + prohibited-use list) / 4. Inputs, Outputs, Actions, and Materials (Generally; Rights and Responsibilities; Reliance on Outputs and Actions; Our use of Materials; Limitations) / 5. Feedback / 6. Subscriptions, fees and payment / 7. Third-party services and links / 8. Content Moderation / 9. Software / 10. Ownership of the Services / 11. Disclaimer of warranties, limitations of liability, and indemnity (No warranties; No limitation; Foreseeable loss; Non-commercial use only; Your rights; Limitation of liability; Beneficiaries) / 12. Data Switching and Portability (EU-specific) / 13. General terms (Changes to Services; Changes to these Terms; Supplemental Terms; Termination; etc.) / 14. In case of disputes.

B. VERBATIM EXCERPTS (Consumer Terms)

(1) AS IS / warranty disclaimer: "The Services, Outputs, and Actions are provided on an 'as is' and 'as available' basis and, to the fullest extent permissible under applicable law, are provided without warranties of any kind, whether express, implied, or statutory. We and our Providers expressly disclaim any and all warranties of fitness for a particular purpose, title, merchantability, accuracy, availability, reliability, security, privacy, compatibility, non-infringement..." Preceded by consumer-rights carve-out: "You may have legal rights in relation to our Services... Other than those legal rights, your use of the Services, Materials, and Actions is solely at your own risk."

(2) Limitation of liability + cap: "our total liability to you for any loss or damage arising out of or in connection with these Terms, whether in contract (including under any indemnity), tort (including negligence) or otherwise will be limited to the greater of: (a) the amount you paid to us for access to or use of the Services in the six months prior to the event giving rise to the liability, and (b) €100." Carve-outs ("No limitation"): "Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits our liability for: death or personal injury caused by our negligence; fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation; and any matter in respect of which it would be unlawful for us to exclude or restrict our liability." Also "Foreseeable loss": "we and our Providers are not responsible for any loss or damage that is not foreseeable." Providers get pass-through protection: "Our Providers may benefit from, and enforce, their rights under this Section."

(3) Indemnity: No user indemnification obligation exists in this EU version — the word appears only in the section 11 title and in the cap clause ("including under any indemnity"). (US version reportedly includes one; not verified here.)

(4) AI output disclaimer: "Artificial intelligence and large language models are frontier technologies that are still improving in accuracy, reliability and safety. When you use our Services, you acknowledge and agree: Outputs may not always be accurate and may contain material inaccuracies even if they appear accurate because of their level of detail or specificity. Actions may not be error free or operate as you intended. You should not rely on any Outputs or Actions without independently confirming their accuracy. The Services and any Outputs may not reflect correct, current, or complete information. Outputs may contain content that is inconsistent with Anthropic's views."

(5) Changes to terms: "We may revise and update these Terms... These changes will come into effect no less than 30 days from when we notify you, unless the change is due to a change in law or for security reasons (in which case we may need to change the Terms on shorter notice)." Plus exit right: "If you do not wish to continue using our Services following any changes to the Terms you can terminate these Terms... before the changes take effect." Separate "Changes to Services" clause: "Our Services are novel and will change. We may sometimes add or remove features... We may modify, suspend, or discontinue the Services or your access" with 30 days' notice "where feasible."

(6) Termination: "You may stop accessing the Services at any time. We may suspend or terminate your access to the Services at any time without notice to you if: we believe that you have materially breached these Terms; we must do so in order to comply with applicable law; or immediate suspension or termination is necessary for security reasons... We may also terminate your Account if you have been inactive for over a year and you do not have a paid Account" (with advance notice).

(7) Minimum age: "Minimum age. You must be at least 18 years old to use the Services."

(8) Third-party services: "We do not control or accept responsibility for any loss or damage that may arise from your use of any Third-Party Content, services, and integrations, for which we make no representations or warranties. Your use of any Third-Party Content, services, and integrations is at your own risk and subject to any terms, conditions, or policies (including privacy policies) applicable to such third-party content."

(9) Feedback: "You have no obligation to give us Feedback, but if you do, you agree that we may use the Feedback however we choose without any obligation or other payment to you." (Rating an Output = the related conversation is stored as Feedback.)

(10) Input/output ownership: "As between you and Anthropic, and to the extent permitted by applicable law, you retain any right, title, and interest that you have in such Inputs. Subject to your compliance with our Terms, we assign to you all our right, title, and interest (if any) in Outputs." User responsibility: "You are responsible for all Inputs you submit to our Services and all Actions. You must ensure that you have all rights, licenses, and permissions that are necessary for us to process such Inputs." Service usage rights: "We may use Materials to provide, maintain, and improve the Services and to develop other products and services, including training our models, unless you opt out of training through your account settings."

(11) Beta/evaluation: "Evaluation and Additional Services. In some cases, we may permit you to evaluate our Services for a limited time or with limited functionality. Use of our Services for evaluation purposes are for your personal, non-commercial use only." Plus Supplemental Terms mechanism for new features.

(12) Free-service language: No dedicated free-tier disclaimer. Relevant hooks: the liability cap keys off "the amount you paid... in the six months prior" (effectively €100 floor for free users); inactive unpaid accounts terminable after 1 year; "Non-commercial use only. You agree that you will not use our Services for any commercial or business purposes and we and our Providers have no liability to you for any loss of profit, loss of business, business interruption, or loss of business opportunity."

C. PRIVACY POLICY (Effective July 8, 2026)
Outline: 1. Collection of Personal Data / 2. Uses of Personal Data Permitted Under Applicable Data Protection Laws / 3. Recipients and Third-Party Data Sources / 4. Rights and Choices / 5. Data Transfers / 6. Data Retention, Data Lifecycle, and Security Controls / 7. Children / 8. Changes to Our Privacy Policy / 9. Contact Information / 10. Legal Bases for Processing / 11. Regional Supplemental Disclosures.
- Categories collected: identity/contact, payment, Inputs/Outputs, feedback, technical (device, connection, usage logs, cookies), communications, verification data.
- Training: opt-out model — "We may use your Inputs and Outputs to train and improve Anthropic AI models, unless you opt out through your account settings." Override: even opted-out data is used when flagged for safety review or explicitly reported by the user.
- Retention: "for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes and criteria outlined in this Privacy Policy"; deleted conversations removed from history immediately and "automatically deleted from our back-end within 30 days."
- Deletion: right to request deletion "subject to certain exceptions"; requests to privacy@anthropic.com, ~30-day response.
- De-identified data: "Where data is de-identified, Anthropic will maintain and use this information in its de-identified form, and will not attempt to re-identify such information, except as permitted by law."
- Security: "appropriate technical and organizational security measures designed to protect personal data from loss, misuse, and unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction" (no technical specifics).
- Children: "not directed towards, and we do not knowingly collect... any information from children under the age of 18."
- Contact: privacy@anthropic.com; DPO dpo@anthropic.com; US + Ireland mailing addresses; regional complaint routes (EU/UK/Brazil/Australia).

D. TONE / UX OBSERVATIONS
- Terms open each heavy section with one plain-language framing sentence before legalese, e.g. section 11 begins: "Our team works hard to provide great services, and we're continuously working on improvements. However, there are certain aspects we can't guarantee."
- Defined terms introduced in bold + quotes at first use, reused consistently (Inputs/Outputs/Actions/Materials/Providers). No summary boxes; readability comes from short labeled sub-clauses ("No warranties.", "Foreseeable loss.", "Your rights.").
- Consumer-friendly reassurance is structural, not decorative: explicit statutory-rights preservation, 30-day notice + refund/exit right on changes, appeal path for content takedowns, advance notice before inactivity termination.
- AI-risk disclosure is a bulleted acknowledgment list (quoted in B4) — candid "frontier technology" framing rather than buried disclaimer; good template for a pilot.
- Usage Policy is the most plain-language doc: "do not" phrasing with concrete examples; structure = Universal Usage Standards → High-Risk Use Case Requirements (human-in-the-loop: "a qualified professional in that field must review the content or decision"; disclosure of AI assistance in legal/health/finance/employment/etc.) → Additional Guidelines, including: consumer-facing chatbots must disclose AI involvement at session start; agentic applications must follow the full policy.
- Pilot-relevant patterns to borrow: evaluation clause (B11) as the free-pilot hook; €100/paid-fees liability floor; opt-out training default with safety-flag override; 30-day deletion pipeline; single 18+ age gate across both docs.
